name: eBool

sources.title: Submit a Listing (403 to automated fetch; details via third party)
eBool: requirements, how to submit, and what you actually get (SubmitMap)

conditions: Free tier exists but carries a ~6-month review queue (stated on the free card itself, per third-party teardown)
Paid one-time tiers shorten review: Premium $47 (2-3 business days, top-5 in one category), Pro $117 (#1 in up to 3 categories for 2 years), Super $197 (adds homepage featured rotation)
requirements: Business software/products only - directory of ~159k products across ~2,000 B2B categories
reCAPTCHA-protected site; /submit blocked automated fetch with 403
preparation: Product name, website URL, description, logo, and the correct software category (e.g. CRM Software, Email Marketing)
Decide free vs. one-time paid placement before opening the form
A vendor account exists ('Vendor Portal' login) - check whether listing management requires it
workflow: Open https://www.ebool.com/submit in a normal browser (automated fetch is blocked)
Pick a tier card: Free / Premium $47 / Pro $117 / Super $197 and click 'Submit Free Listing' (or the paid equivalent)
Complete the listing form with product and category details
Free: expect roughly a 6-month queue; paid: 2-3 business days review
watchFor: All paid tiers are one-time payments and advertise a full refund if the listing is not accepted (per third-party teardown)
The free queue is extremely long (~6 months) - plan accordingly
Homepage 'Get Listed' copy sells one-time permanent placement; confirm the free path is still offered on the live form
Featured placements ($47+) buy position, not guaranteed inclusion - editorial review still applies
countsAsLive: A public product page exists under the relevant eBool category (e.g. /crm-software/<product>) and is reachable from category listings.
unknowns: Exact form fields (submit page 403'd to automated fetch)
Whether a vendor account is required to submit
